An '''armband''' belonged to [[Nomi Sunrider]], who reluctantly took up [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after the death of her husband, [[Andur Sunrider|Andur]]. The item gave a boost to one's power when fighting against the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

The [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] may have come across this relic during her travels in [[3951 BBY]].
